component.name: rFerram
component.summary: Zero-copy QUIC remote display application for COSMIC and modern desktops

description.p: rFerram is a hyper-optimized, zero-copy, cross-platform remote display application built in pure Rust. It combines UDP-backed QUIC transport (quinn + rustls), hardware video pipelines (AV1, H.265, H.264), native VPN adapter binding (WireGuard, Tailscale, UniFi), and snapshot-backed file synchronization.
